description:
Description from T-S J1.16:
Bifolio of accounts in Judaeo-Arabic. Dating: 11th or 12th century. The hand may be known. Each entry is boxed. Each page seems to have mostly transactions relating to a single person. Mentions: Ḥayyim Ibn Madīnī; Abū ʿImrān the son of the sister of Hilāl; ʿAlī; Ḥusayn; the price of a handle (or pestle?) for a mortar for a woman; Aḥmad (then mentions a nizārī dinar); Ḥasan al-Simsār; Yosef; al-Ṣabiyy; Ḥusayn al-Naḥḥās; Yaḥyā; al-sabbāk; a ḥaddād. 

Description from T-S Ar.35.173:
Accounts in Arabic script and Judaeo-Arabic. Dating: 11th or 12th century. Mentions Yehuda b. Ismāʿīl al-Andalusī; Abū l-Faraj Ṣemaḥ; ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz. Entries are circled/boxed.

Description from T-S NS 83.18:
Business accounts. Bifolio from a ledger. In a mixture of Judaeo-Arabic and Arabic script. Dating: 11th century. There are several fingerprints. Most entries are boxed and/or crossed out. Many entries are introduced with the phrase "al-bāqī ʿinda X baʿda qaṭʿ al-ḥisāb." People mentioned: ʿAlī; al-ṣabiyy al-ṣaghīr; Abū Isḥāq Ibrāhīm; Maḥbūb; Aḥmad; ghulām al-ṭabīb; Ḥasan; Ismāʿīl; Mūsā; Ibn al-Ashqar; Ḥayyim; Abū l-Ḥasan; Ḥasan b. Naḥum; Saʿāda; Ḥusayn b. L[...]; Ḥayyim b. Madīnī, probably identical with the well-known Abū Zikrī Ḥayyim b. ʿAmmār Ibn al-Madīnī ("son of the Palermitan"). 

Description from T-S NS 320.125:
Bifolio from an account ledger. Dating: Probably 11th century. In a mixture of Judaeo-Arabic and Arabic script, many entries boxed and/or crossed out. 

Description from T-S AS 149.35:
Accounts, mentioning names such as Abū l-Faraj Mardūkh and Abū Isḥāq, and several sums of money. (Information from CUDL)

Description from T-S AS 179.146:
Mercantile accounts in Arabic script. Most entries are boxed.

Description from T-S AS 201.82:
Bifolio from an account book. In Judaeo-Arabic and Arabic script. Dating: 11th or 12th century. Many entries boxed and/or crossed out. The sums are fairly high (e.g. 44 dinars in one line). Mentions names such as Mūsā; Abū Sahl Menashshe; Abū l-Ḥasan; Abū Naṣr al-Ṭaḥḥān; Abū Zikrī; Ḥusayn; and Ḥasan. 

Joins: Alan Elbaum.
description_he: ביפוליו מספר חשבונות. בערבית-יהודית ובכתב ערבי. תאריך: המאה ה-11 או ה-12. ערכים רבים ממוסגרים ו/או מחוקים. הסכומים גבוהים (למשל 44 דינרים בשורה אחת). מזכיר שמות כגון מוסא; אבו סהל מנשה; אבו אל-חסן; אבו נצר אל-טחן; אבו זכרי; חֻסַין; וחסן.
